why: Authoring the first Area 1 sections put four independent readers on the official CMR text with instructions to follow the source over a rule summary and report any divergence. None found a rule summary that CONTRADICTS its authority. Several found summaries that UNDER-SPECIFY the authority they themselves cite, which is the defect class that has driven repair rounds: a section can only teach what a rule carries, so a thin summary silently caps what the guide can say.

classes.under_specified_rule_summary: The rule cites an authority whose content it does not carry.
classes.uncovered_provision: Official text with real examination value that no canonical rule carries at all.
classes.official_text_oddity: An inconsistency inside the official source itself; nothing to fix, worth knowing.

findings.detail: One generic sentence against four distinct 14-day duties: online licensing profile contact details; name change with sworn statement, photo ID copy and any further Board documentation; ANY ARREST, pending criminal charge or conviction, the duty attaching at arrest; and disciplinary action as defined in 247 CMR 2.00 or loss of certification.
Skips 4.02(2), the late-renewal route on payment of an annual fee, applicable back fees and a late fee. It is what makes the 'I paid this morning, may I work?' question answerable.
Omits 3.02(1)(d), reciprocity fees non-refundable once reviewed and acted upon, and 3.02(3)(a)1, the Board must receive an official FPGEC certificate copy from NABP on the non-approved-school branch.

Says a covered registrant completes 'additional' annual compounding hours. The official text allocates subject matter inside the 20-hour annual minimum rather than adding to it, and the released bank treats the law hours as counting within the 20.

Compresses the evaluation duty to 'evaluate the program'. The text is 'faculty, learning experiences, instructional methods, facilities and educational resources'. A released question is keyed to the fuller version.
Renders a proof provision as a quantity provision. 4.03(3) is a statement submitted with the renewal application under the penalties of perjury; the summary drops the mechanism.
Omits the qualifier 'except where otherwise prohibited by federal or state laws and regulations'.
Omits the required training-program topic list, so no section can teach what an approved programme must cover.
Pharmacy intern licence eligibility. Who may become an intern at all is untaught while supervision and hours are taught.
Internship hours may be acquired throughout a calendar year. A released question's distractor turns on it.
CE provider application contents including the eight permitted subject areas, academic courses, education methods and faculty competence documentation.
Closed by MA-RX-FORMAT-CONTENT in this session; listed so the class is visible.
Heading says ACPE-accredited AND Board-approved; operative 3.01(1)(b) says OR.
Identical sentence reads 'may register with NABP to take MPJE' in one branch and 'must' in the other.
Cross-references 247 CMR 4.11, which does not exist; the chapter runs 4.01 to 4.08.
Says 'registered pharmacy preceptor' where 8.01(3) and 8.01(16) say 'pharmacist preceptor'.

how_to_use: An under-specified summary is corrected by enriching the rule, which is only safe where no RELEASED question's final adjudication snapshots it. Check that first; where it is snapshotted the correction waits for a question-lane cycle. An uncovered provision needs a new additive rule, which has no blast radius.
